title: Message actions
summary: The sheet that opens on a long press (or a right click) on a message. It shows a row of quick reactions and the actions that apply to that message, in the chat type (DM or group) and for the sender.

kind.description: One row of the sheet, in this order.

itemId.description: The timeline item id of the message.

quickReactions.description: Six emoji: the person's most used, else the default set in notes. Each shows as selected when the person already reacted with it.

actions.description: Rows that apply. reply: canBeRepliedTo. copy: the message has text. edit: isEditable. delete: own message with canOwnUserRedactOwn, or another's in a group with canOwnUserRedactOther. report: not own. retry and cancelSend: own message with a failed send.

open.effect: Opens the sheet with a light haptic and lifts the message above it.

react.effect: Timeline.toggleReaction and closes. A tap on the + at the end opens the system emoji keyboard (message-reactions).

choose.effect: reply: message-reply. copy: copies the plain text, shows bipe_app_copied. edit: message-edit. delete: message-delete. report: the report flow of people and profiles (bipe-chat/bipe#567). retry: Timeline.retrySend. cancelSend: Timeline.abortSend.

notes: Not in a DM (ADR 0141): threads, pin, copy link to the message. Phase 1 has no threads, pins or message links in groups either.
Forward and select are composer and media work (bipe-chat/bipe#563, #561), not phase 1 of this sheet.
A redacted message, a date separator, a scam warning or a notice line has no sheet.
